## Build Failure Analysis — `BuildDiag.sln`

### Solution structure
```
BuildDiag.sln
├── Core.csproj        (net8.0, library)
├── Services.csproj    (net8.0, library) → references Core
└── Api.csproj         (net8.0, exe)     → references Services + Core
```

### Root cause (1 of 1): Missing NuGet package in `Services.csproj`

**`Services/UserService.cs`** uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (`using Newtonsoft.Json` at line 2, `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq` at line 3, `JObject` at line 22), but **`Services.csproj` has no `<PackageReference>` for `Newtonsoft.Json`**. Its `project.assets.json` confirms only a project reference to `Core` — no NuGet packages at all.

This produces **3 compiler errors**, all in `Services.csproj`:

| Error | Location | Description |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| CS0246 | `UserService.cs:2` | `Newtonsoft` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | `UserService.cs:3` | `Newtonsoft` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | `UserService.cs:22` | `JObject` type not found |

### Cascading failure

- **`Api.csproj`** — never reached the `Csc` (compile) step because its dependency `Services.csproj` failed first. This is **not an independent error**; it will resolve once `Services` builds.

### Fix

Add the missing package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

Then run `dotnet restore` and rebuild.
